title: Pasilla Drosophila RNAi knock-down gene-count fixture
kind: study data included as package demonstration fixture

provenance.status: observed study data, copied into the DESeq2 package for demonstration
provenance.source_observations: Drosophila melanogaster cell cultures; RNAi knock-down of splicing factor pasilla, compared by condition
adaptations: The DESeq2 vignette states the data were copied into inst/extdata; counts are presented as a gene count matrix and an annotation table.

biological_context.experimental_units: 7 named samples/cell culture libraries are represented in sample annotation; exact biological replicate structure not independently validated
biological_context.design: condition (treated/untreated) and sequencing type metadata; vignette tests pasilla RNAi knock-down and separately adjusts for type

assets.processing_stage: gene-level exon counts copied from Pasilla package; used as unnormalized input
assets.relationship: count matrix paired with sample annotation after matching sample IDs/order
matching metadata; vignette warns initial order differs from count columns and trims fb suffix before reordering

access_and_terms.access: Publicly viewable through DESeq2 GitHub repository at pinned revision; no credential requirement observed.
access_and_terms.redistribution: Unknown for underlying Pasilla observations. DESeq2 DESCRIPTION says package license LGPL (>=3), but this alone does not establish terms for the included data; verify original data package terms before reuse.
evidence: DESeq2 DESCRIPTION at pinned revision reports License: LGPL (>= 3); vignette lines 411-416 says copied from pasilla package

checked: GitHub tree metadata for bundled assets and byte sizes
vignette descriptions of source, condition, type, and required sample reordering
Brooks2010 citation DOI in vignette bibliography
not_checked: Original pasilla package documentation, processed-data provenance, and redistribution terms
Raw sequencing accession and original sample-level study metadata

limitations: No accession or count-file hash was stated in inspected sources.
Reported annotation numeric metrics were read from CSV; read totals were not independently recomputed.
Data are a package demonstration copy; suitability for a new benchmark and licensing of the data require confirmation.

title: tximportData Salmon quantification demonstration inputs

adaptations: Vignette creates artificial condition labels A and B for demonstration.

access_and_terms.redistribution: Unknown; no package license or data terms inspected.
